narrative.overview:
A neighbourhood record shop after closing: warm dark wood bins, kraft divider cards lettered in condensed capitals, a few bright price stickers, and the record you are about to play pulled up out of the crate. The app is played in a dim room from a stand's distance, so it is dark only, roomy, and set in text large enough to read from there.

The world lends colour, type, density and one signature move (the lifted sleeve), and nothing else. Controls stay ordinary native web controls styled in the palette; the page stays a plain single column. There are no crate graphics, wood grain or paper textures, no gradients outside sleeve art, and no shadow except the lifted sleeve's floor. Nothing moves while you play except the canvas keyboard.

It must never read as childish or gamified (badges, mascots, confetti, scores), as intimidating pro gear (DAW, rack, bezel, VU meters), or as generic SaaS (floating cards, gradients, a blue button).
keyCharacteristics: Flat walnut-black ground with flat brown cards, each topped by a kraft tab.
Each sound owns one colour everywhere: sleeve, zone strip, lit keys, its sliders.
Yellow marks the next thing to do (plus the ON sticker and focus); green marks done.
Round stickers carry state, and state always shows in shape as well as colour.
Native controls (buttons, selects, checkboxes, radios, ranges) restyled, never replaced.
The 61-key canvas keyboard sits full width in a dark well, in one fixed place.

rules.name: The No Red Rule
rules.body: There is no red anywhere. A problem (sound failed, MIDI refused) is a yellow hint with one clear next step. Out-of-scale notes are dimmed toward `well`, never red.

rules.name: The Next Step Rule
rules.body: Yellow means the next step. At most one yellow button and one yellow ring show at a time: a button gets the primary style only on the card whose setup step is "now", and loses it once that step is done. Yellow's only other jobs are the ON sticker, hints and the focus outline.

rules.name: The One Colour Per Sound Rule
rules.body: A sound's colour belongs to that sound and follows it everywhere it appears in the UI. No other control or state borrows a sound colour, and a new sound gets a new colour.

rules.name: The Shape Too Rule
rules.body: Meaning never rides on colour alone: a done step shows a check mark, the current step a solid ring, a step to do a dashed outline; a chosen sleeve is raised and wears an ON sticker; a disabled control is dimmed to 45%.

rules.name: The Dark Only Rule
rules.body: There is one theme, dark (`color-scheme: dark`). No light theme is planned.

rules.name: The Tab-Only Display Rule
rules.body: Big Shoulders appears on the wordmark and the divider tabs and nowhere else.

rules.name: The Self-Hosted Fonts Rule
rules.body: Every font ships from `src/assets/fonts/` with its source and license listed in [`src/assets/LICENSES.md`](src/assets/LICENSES.md). No font CDN or runtime third-party request.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: The lifted sleeve's floor shadow is the only shadow in the system.

rules.name: The Native Controls Rule
rules.body: Every control is a native button, select, checkbox, radio or range, restyled with the tokens. Chips and sleeves are hidden native radios under a label; no custom widget, knob or fader replaces one.

rules.name: The No Notation Rule
rules.body: No sheet music or notation anywhere. Prompts and labels use note names (spelled by key), chord symbols and Roman numerals.

rules.name: The Redraw On Change Rule
rules.body: The canvas keyboard and the live readout redraw in one animation frame scheduled only after a change, never per note through React, and nothing else on screen moves while you play.

dos: Do give every new sound its own colour and use it on its sleeve, zone strip, lit keys and sliders.
Do keep exactly one yellow action on screen: the next step.
Do show state in shape as well as colour (check mark, solid ring, dashed outline, raised sleeve, dimming).
Do use native controls (button, select, checkbox, radio, range) restyled with the tokens.
Do redraw the canvas keyboard only in an animation frame after a change.
Do dim out-of-scale notes toward `well` in jam mode.
Do put text on stickers, tabs and the primary button in `bin`, never white.
Do self-host every font and list it in `src/assets/LICENSES.md`.
donts: Don't use red anywhere, for errors, wrong notes or anything else.
Don't show sheet music or notation; use note names, chord symbols and Roman numerals.
Don't replace native controls with custom widgets, knobs or faders.
Don't use yellow for decoration, emphasis or a second action; its jobs are the next step, the ON sticker, hints and focus.
Don't add shadows, gradients, borders on cards, wood grain or paper textures.
Don't animate anything during play except the canvas keyboard.
Don't use Big Shoulders outside the wordmark and tabs, or set new DOM text below 14px.
Don't add badges, mascots, confetti or scores, or a DAW, rack or VU-meter look.
